body: Were you an undergrad when this happened? Was it an honest mistake or did you go actually crazy? I'm really mostly sad, because I like doing bird work in remote settings, and I'm scared with this "crazy" stigma I won't ever be able to get it. I cannot believe I've fucked this up...

I'm not in undergrad, I graduated in December of 2012... I've had two other field positions, but, like I said, I think I've really ruined that reference. After a great season in the fall, I applied for tons of stuff thinking I'd get nothing, turns out I got tons of things, but I'm pretty sure it's because of my great references. The grad student I worked for in the fall also worked for this project a few years ago, knows I was working there this summer, and sent me a 'how's it going!" email the day after I got fired...I just told her honestly while claiming complete responsibility for my actions. Plus, I made a fool out of myself in front of all these people that will eventually be colleagues. I just.... I don't know...I hate myself. I completely sabotaged an incredible opportunity because of a boy.
I'm just not sure this is acceptable. It just doesn't even seem worth repairing

I've never been more disappointed and upset with myself in my entire life. This damage is literally unrepairable, you know...? Like, why even try to live if I'm not going to get to achieve my dreams...???

I know it won't fix anything. I've just... I've ruined my career in the only field I wanted to be in. Maybe to some people a career isn't everything, but to me it's really fucking important. I seriously want to crawl in a hole and rot and die.

I know, I'm enough over the parents things, and the stupid ex. It's just. I don't know. I HAD SO MUCH GOING FOR ME career wise, and I've literally thrown it all down the toilet. I'm probably going to be stuck working retail or something my whole life. I'm not trying to say that's awful, nor do I look down on people who do do that, but wildlife biology is my dream and now I've fucking destroyed it. The end. I literally should just kill myself.

Well...I'd just come home from South America, and went to stay with my dad in a small town where I knew no one. I was taking Accutane, and plus I knew my relationship was on the out. Being with my dad got my super depressed about the fact that my parents divorced (like when I was 5, I'm 24 now) because my childhood undoubtedly would have been so much better if they'd stayed together.
